permits:
  exec: ["git"]
  net: { http: ["api.github.com"] }
  tools: ["nika:fetch", "nika:write"]

run:
  entropy: { seeded: 7 }
  clock: virtual

tasks:
  log:
    exec: { command: ["git", "log", "${{ inputs.since }}..HEAD"] }
  draft:
    with: { log: "${{ tasks.log.output }}" }
    infer:
      prompt: "Draft release notes from: ${{ with.log }}"
      max_tokens: 600
  polish:
    with: { draft: "${{ tasks.draft.output }}" }
    agent:
      prompt: "Tighten, save to ${{ const.out }}: ${{ with.draft }}"
      tools: ["nika:write"]
      max_tokens_total: 4096
  publish:
    with: { notes: "${{ tasks.polish.output }}" }
    invoke:
      tool: "nika:fetch"
      args:
        url: "https://api.github.com/repos/acme/app/issues"
        method: POST
        headers: { Authorization: "Bearer ${{ secrets.token }}" }
        body: { title: "Release notes", body: "${{ with.notes }}" }

outputs:
  notes: ${{ tasks.polish.output }}
